old_value: {"id":"fedistract-xzkb.31","title":"fedi-e2ee panics on invalid Ed25519 pubkey","description":"ed25519_to_x25519_public() at fedi-e2ee/src/lib.rs:200 calls .expect() on CompressedEdwardsY::decompress(). If the recipient's Ed25519 public key (sourced from a remote actor's DID document) is not a valid curve point, this panics and crashes the server.
